      "observations": [
        "Read every owned hunk across all eight paths. This phase removes runAsync, readURLasUTF8, ddump and alertPrompt definitions/exports, converts the old non-Error Exception prototype to an Error subclass and updates dependent exception constructors to class/extends/super forms. The next 4378 phase removes the remaining empty wrapper; it is not the source of this class/cause conversion.",
        "ServerException gains a cause argument and passes it to super(message, { cause }), retaining code, uri and url. CancelOthersException and MalformedException switch from .call-based parent construction to extends/super. Those dependent constructors matter when a parent changes from a callable function to a class; this is not merely a spelling change or a mandate to convert unrelated functions.",
        "Check removed-export consumers at the exact historical phase. The legacy accountSetup.js still imports alertPrompt and calls it in setError's catch path after a warning/info DOM update fails, while the utility export is removed. This is a bounded historical stale-binding concern; it was not exercised. The whole legacy file is absent at the fixed accepted revision, so it is not reported as current UI behavior.",
        "CreateInBackend replaces ddump with direct warning/error logger calls. Read actual own/current preference-save handling: the catch and Could not write out prefs warning remain. D277844's reviewer suggestion to drop them is Not Done and is not adopted in this source. That suggestion establishes no general try/catch or logging rule.",
        "GuessConfig moves immutable probe status/protocol constants before functions, builds computed socket-type port/command tables, uses explicit Ci.nsMsgSocketType values instead of exported NONE/STARTTLS/SSL aliases, changes reassigned bindings to let and stable bindings to const, and replaces two value-only indexed loops with for...of. Remaining protocol IDs are module-specific, not the nsMsgSocketType enum.",
        "The resultConfig and which defaults change from broad falsy checks to ??=. Valid callers supply an AccountConfig or missing value and incoming/outgoing/both direction strings. The two forms are not equivalent for arbitrary false, 0 or empty-string input; this cleanup is not generalized into a defaulting rule for other APIs.",
        "Read all owned test registration and assertion-helper hunks. Both test files replace run_test/manual calls with named add_task registrations and replace the custom assert_equal wrapper with direct Assert.equal calls. The rewritten shared scalar helpers have nonempty messages, though their failure wording lacks should; missing should alone is not a defect in another author's code. Several pre-existing direct XML assertions in converted tasks still omit messages; wrapping a task does not add those messages or new functional coverage.",
        "The POP and IMAP specified-socket loops remain for (ssl in [ ... ]). They enumerate array property names, pass those keys to getIncomingTryOrder and expect the same key back. The explicit cases above separately test the intended socket values. This is a narrow loop-oracle gap, not a claim that all socket values are untested or that for...in is always invalid.",
        "Actual helper tests check protocol/socket/port values and order; their TODO still says commands need testing. The XML task's first complete fixture checks skipped unsupported protocol/socket/auth entries and the chosen IMAP/POP/SMTP values. Other touched task boundaries retain OAuth/alternative/auth-method assertions already shown in the owned hunks; converting registration does not prove fresh XML/network behavior.",
        "The fixed accepted HostDetector._checkFinished now has later async localization/error-state changes, and Sanitizer later becomes InputSanitizer. Only the exact constants, class constructors, logger paths and test loops described here are used as current comparisons. No later owned phase or additional audit credit is inferred from these surviving source windows.",
        "Read full D277844 creation-to-final timeline and actual submitted inline 1513554. The reviewer accepts while suggesting dropping the preference-save warning; actual source retains it. Later author Try, remote completion and rebase reports remain historical and no linked job was opened. No summary/test-plan edit or other required inline body is missing.",

It separates all three patches, identifies weaker Owl installation coverage, reports later both-UI/platform QA and prompt flow, and has no Owl-authentication result. Related regressions and See Also bug bodies remain unread. No runtime, lint, formatter, browser, TLS or test execution.",
        "Reuse complete primary Bug 2008517 from 4378's exact read and registered parent capture; no second body read or independent browser confirmation. The author separates the modernization from abortable removal and generic-wrapper removal. Owl coverage and later QA reports retain their original limits.",
        "Read complete D277844 creation-to-final timeline and actual old-diff inline 1513554. The reviewer accepts and proposes dropping the preference-save warning; the owned and fixed accepted source retain that catch/warning. This Not Done proposal is not adopted and does not establish a global logging or exception-handling rule.",

Direct socket constants and test registration modernization do not repair the retained array-key loops, and the XML task conversion does not add runtime or missing assertion messages.",
